items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: I heard Red Happy and Henry Zeno and all, Mac Morris and all those guys.

ctx.x: How did, and what did he play Paul Shalini?

Well I don't know what he played. I know the clarinet was, one of his instruments, but he taught all the instruments. He taught everything. Because that's when I, before he started taking a clarinet, I went to him, you know. And he was going to teach me. But I decided I want the low end drums. I heard Red Happy and Henry Zeno and all, Mac Morris and all those guys. And I said, well, I'll switch the drums. So there you are. But clarinet, I really don't want a clarinet. I was cut out for clarinet. I don't know why.…
How did you get the name of T-Boy too?
